title: StrlSchV 2018 Anlage 4 Tabelle 1: clearance (Freigabe) values in Bq/g

source.citation: Strahlenschutzverordnung (StrlSchV 2018), Anlage 4 Tabelle 1 (Freigrenzen, Freigabewerte, Werte der Oberflächenkontamination) and Tabelle 2 (Tochternuklide)
source.edition: StrlSchV of 29 Nov 2018, BGBl. I 2018, 2034; Stand: Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 10 G v. 23.10.2024 I Nr. 324; Anlage 4 as published by gesetze-im-internet.de (XML build 20250805215502); HRQ and half-life columns not read
source.jurisdiction: Germany (Federal Republic; the StrlSchV applies in all Länder)
source.scope: Activity concentration in Bq/g for unrestricted clearance of solid and liquid material (Freigabe, column 3) and for specific clearance routes (columns 6-11 and 14: rubble over 1000 Mg/a, soil, landfill and incineration up to 100 and 1000 Mg/a, scrap metal for recycling). Surface values (Bq/cm2), the total-activity Freigrenze and the HRQ and half-life columns are not converted. Choosing a table and a route is a regulatory decision for the analyst; a clearance decision also needs the conditions of sections 31 to 42 and Anlage 8.

responses.basis: StrlSchV 2018 Anlage 4 Tabelle 1 Spalte 3 ('Freigrenze, uneingeschränkte Freigabe von festen u. flüssigen Stoffen in Bq/g'): unrestricted clearance of solid and liquid material (also the Freigrenze as specific activity). Bq/g converted to Bq/kg (x1000). A blank cell means the table gives no value for that nuclide in this column, so the nuclide has no coefficient in this response. A parent marked '+' includes the daughters listed in Tabelle 2; covered_by_parent lists them (zero contribution while the parent is present). Column 3 is the Freigrenze as specific activity and also the level for unrestricted clearance of solid and liquid material (Freigabe, sections 31 to 42 and Anlage 8).
